limitations: Dashboard selected range was exactly 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-17, viewed on 2026-11-18 KST.
Facebook did not provide account-level reach in the inspected views dashboard; it is not inferred from views or viewing accounts.
Content detail panels exposed current totals without a selectable date range; therefore content values are stored as current/lifetime snapshots, separate from 30-day account metrics.
No saves or reposts metric was displayed in the inspected content panels; null means unavailable, not zero.
Opaque content IDs are retained from dashboard URLs; no unverified post-ID mapping was made.
Read-only UI collection. No publishing, settings, storage, email, or pre-existing-tab actions were performed.
YouTube displays rounded watch time (hours) and may distinguish content-list view counts from Analytics counts; both observed values are retained where they differ.
Saves, shares, and reposts are not exposed in the inspected Studio UI, so null means unavailable, not zero.
48-hour dashboard card provides a rolling label but no explicit start/end timestamps; boundaries are derived from capturedAt.
No 11/11 country list was used. The only country stated in the current inspected UI is Russia in the current content-list tooltip for WINNYq_TNiM.
